summary: Ming Shing Group Holdings Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 4, 2026, disclosing the resignation of CEO and director Han Yan and independent director Dongjie Lao for personal reasons with no disagreement. The board temporarily re-designated Chairman Zhijun Pan as CEO effective June 4, 2026, and appointed Tianhang Zhao as compensation committee chair. A search for a permanent CEO is underway. This is a forced management departure event, not a routine circular or meeting notice. Watch for further CEO appointment announcements and any potential impact on governance or strategic direction.
